tagline: A dynamic island for any desktop
brief: An open-source, Rust-built dynamic island for any desktop: a black pill at the top of the screen that morphs between the clock, music, notifications and timers. The identity should feel elegant and premium, in black and white only.
criteria: Success: ownable serif monogram, legible at 16 px, strong in one colour, with a detail that links to the island.

concepts.name: OI
concepts.idea: A high-contrast serif O and I, whose I carries a pill-shaped top serif: the island hanging from the screen edge.
rationale: OI reads as the monogram of open-island and as a letter pair at once
The pill serif is the one ownable detail and doubles as the hyphen in the wordmark
A heavier small-size cut and a thinned reversed cut keep it crisp at 16 px and on black

recommendation: OI with the pill serif: the only mark in the exploration that is elegant, literally about the product, and legible at 16 px.
next_steps: Replace the Noto Serif Display wordmark with custom letters if the project grows
Run a trademark search before wide use
